script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Welcome to our regional office. Before you begin your visit, let me go over a few important details.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Visitor badges must be worn at all times and returned to the front desk before you leave the building.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: The cafeteria on the second floor is available for all visitors between 11:30 and 2 p.m.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: If you need Wi-Fi access, the guest network password is printed on the back of your visitor badge.

questions.question: Who is this announcement intended for?
What must visitors do with their badge before leaving?
choices: Return it to the front desk

questions.question: Where can visitors find the Wi-Fi password?
choices: On the back of their badge

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the launch event for our newest smart home device.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Over the next hour, our product team will walk you through its key features and live demonstrations.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Following the presentation, there will be a Q&A session where you can ask our engineers directly.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Refreshments will be available in the lobby throughout the event, so please help yourselves at any time.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: This is a follow-up announcement regarding last night's scheduled system maintenance.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: We are pleased to report that the maintenance was completed successfully ahead of schedule.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: All systems, including email and the internal file server, are now fully operational.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: If you continue to experience any issues, please submit a ticket to the IT help desk immediately.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Attention passengers. A black umbrella was found on the platform of Track 4 this morning.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: If this item belongs to you, please come to the station office located near the main entrance.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: You will be asked to describe the item in detail before it can be returned to you.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Unclaimed items will be transferred to the central lost and found office after seven days.

Where should the owner go to claim the item?
choices: The station office near the main entrance

questions.question: What happens to unclaimed items after seven days?
choices: They are transferred to the central lost and found

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Welcome to this brief overview of how to access our new online training modules.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: You can log in to the training portal using the same credentials as your company email account.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Each module takes about twenty minutes to complete and includes a short quiz at the end.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: All employees are required to complete the first three modules by the end of next month.

questions.question: What is this announcement explaining?
How can employees log in to the training portal?
choices: With a new password sent by mail

questions.question: What must all employees do by next month?

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: I'd like to update everyone on the timeline for our move to the new office building downtown.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Packing materials will be distributed to all desks starting next Monday, and boxes should be labeled clearly.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: The physical move will take place over the weekend of the 20th, so please have your desks cleared by Friday.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: We expect to resume normal operations at the new location the following Monday morning.

questions.question: What is the announcement about?
When will packing materials be distributed?
When will normal operations resume?
choices: At the end of the month

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Thank you all for being here. Today I'll be presenting the results of our latest customer satisfaction survey.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Overall satisfaction increased by twelve percent compared to last year, largely due to faster response times.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: However, customers noted that our product packaging could be improved for easier recycling.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: Based on this feedback, the product team will begin reviewing packaging options next quarter.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: As our headquarters relocates next month, we want to help you plan your new commute.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: The new building is located two blocks from Central Station, making it easily accessible by train.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: For those who drive, a parking garage is available on-site, though spaces are limited and assigned by seniority.

script.speaker: Narrator
script.line: A detailed commuting guide with maps and public transit options will be emailed to everyone next week.

How far is the new building from Central Station?
choices: It is not near the station
